description: Projected Intensity-Duration-Frequency (IDF) Curve Data Tool for the Chesapeake Bay Watershed and Virginia is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Mid-Atlantic Regional Integrated Sciences and Assessments. This interactive tool makes climate-change informed intensity-duration-frequency (IDF) curves available to view and download for counties across the Chesapeake Bay Watershed and Virginia. Using the tool, IDF curves can be easily integrated and used to plan, design, and build infrastructure assets to be more resilient to climate change. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
